entity.name: Nathan Ramos, CFA
entity.description: Founder and sole maintainer of pyeconomics, an open platform of economics and finance models.

projects.name: pyeconomics
projects.description: An open platform of economics and finance models: a registry of tested, cited models served identically to Python, a command line, a REST API, an MCP server and a web app, with a provenance manifest on every result. The library, CLI, local app and MCP server stay free and open source.
